subject: POC kickoff & timeline - Acme Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acme.com>, Taylor Smith <taylor.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff & timeline - Acme Industries

Hi Alex / Taylor -

Thanks again for the conversation today - great to learn more about Acme's evaluation priorities. Quick recap from our side and a proposed plan to get the POC running next week:

Summary / Success criteria (as I understood it):
- Validate retrieval + generation pipeline latency under representative load (95th percentile target < 650ms).
- Achieve embedding-based semantic search accuracy for the 3 test prompts (F1 improvement >= 12% vs current baseline).
- Confirm integration with Acme's S3 holding docs and ability to enforce retention TTLs via KMS.

Proposed POC scope / evaluation plan:
1) 2-week technical POC with a sandbox dataset (up to 50,000 docs).
2) Kickoff meeting + alignment on datasets and test prompts.
3) Weekly check-ins (30 min) to review metrics and blockers.
4) Final readout with demo and go/no-go decision.

Timeline (proposed):
- Mon 17 May - Kickoff (30-45 min) + dataset handoff
- Weekly checkpoints: Tue 25 May, Tue 1 Jun
- Fri 4 Jun - Final readout (stakeholders + SRE)

Owners:
- Redwood: me (AE) + Vivek (solutions engineer) + Rishi (platform engineer for infra/setup)
- Acme: Alex (PM) + Taylor (data owner) + Priya (security)

Next steps:
- Can you confirm the success criteria above and the two-week window?
- Please share the dataset access instructions (S3 URI + least-privilege IAM user) or a sample export by EOD Friday.

Attached is a rough mutual action plan and a short POC checklist to help with sign-off.

Thanks - looking forward to running this with you.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ACME_POC_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx]
[Attachment: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf]

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acme.com>

Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & timeline - Acme Industries

Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap. That matches our internal goals pretty closely. A few clarifications / tweaks from our side:

- On accuracy: we'll provide the three canonical prompts and an evaluation rubric (precision/recall targets) by Friday.
- On latency: 650ms 95p is acceptable as a target but can you also include a p50 and p99 in the dashboard? Those matter to our frontend team.
- Dataset access: we'll provision a read-only IAM user and send credentials via the secure portal (Priya is on copy).

Timeline works for us, but a couple asks:
1) Can kickoff move to Tue 18 May at 10:00 PT instead of Mon 17? Alex / Taylor have a standing sync on Mon.
2) Can you confirm any expected cost or credit consumption for the POC environment (we need to log it against the proof-of-value budget)?

Thanks - Tue 18 May at 10:00 PT works for us. I've updated the tentative schedule below and added owners for each milestone.

Updated timeline / milestones:
- Tue 18 May, 10:00 PT - Kickoff (30-45 min) - confirm dataset & test prompts - Owner: Marissa + Alex
- Tue 25 May, 10:00 PT - Week 1 check-in - share initial latency/accuracy dashboards - Owner: Vivek
- Tue 1 Jun, 10:00 PT - Week 2 check-in - address any regressions and finalize runbook - Owner: Rishi
- Fri 4 Jun, 11:00 PT - Final readout (demo + decision) - Owner: Marissa + Alex

I've uploaded an editable mutual action plan to the shared Drive link (see below) - please add your stakeholders and any additional success criteria you want to track.

Drive: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/0BxyZPOC_MutualAction

Thanks - I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue 18, and attach the final mutual action plan after any edits.

Best,
